privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how VidForge collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our AI video generation service.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect account information (name, email), uploaded media and prompts, usage data, billing records, and technical data such as IP address and device type needed to operate the service.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and improve the service, process payments, send transactional notices, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: Data sharing
sections.body: We share data with trusted service providers (hosting, payment processors, AI model providers) only as needed to operate VidForge. All providers are bound by confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.body: We retain your data while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards for legal and billing purposes. You may request deletion at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. Contact support@vidforge.ai to exercise these rights.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies for authentication and preferences, and optional analytics cookies. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy? Email support@vidforge.ai.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using VidForge you agree to these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.body: By creating an account or using the service you agree to be bound by these terms and our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Service description
sections.body: VidForge provides AI-powered video generation from text and images. Features and models may change over time.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and for all activity under your account.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not use VidForge to generate illegal, infringing, harassing, or deceptive content, or to violate any law or third-party rights.

sections.title: Credits and billing
sections.body: Credits are consumed per generation. Subscriptions and credit packages are billed as described on the pricing page. Unused credits may expire per plan terms.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: You retain rights to content you generate subject to the model provider's terms. VidForge retains rights to the platform and its branding.

sections.title: Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may cancel your account at any time.

sections.title: Disclaimer and liability
sections.body: The service is provided as-is without warranties. To the maximum extent permitted by law, VidForge is not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms; continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: We want you to be happy with VidForge. This policy explains refunds for subscriptions and credits.

sections.title: Eligibility
sections.body: Refund requests within 7 days of purchase for unused subscription periods or unused credit packages may be eligible.

sections.title: Non-refundable
sections.body: Credits already consumed for generations are non-refundable. Custom enterprise agreements follow their own terms.

sections.title: Process
sections.body: Email support@vidforge.ai with your account email and order details. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

sections.title: Credits
sections.body: Unused credits from a refunded package are removed from your balance. Promotional credits are non-refundable.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions? Email support@vidforge.ai.

contact.title: Contact Us

sections.title: Email

sections.title: Business inquiries

sections.title: Abuse reports

sections.title: Response time
sections.body: We typically respond within 1–2 business days.

reportAbuse.title: Report Abuse
reportAbuse.intro: Help us keep VidForge safe. Report abusive, illegal, or rights-infringing content.

sections.title: What to report
sections.body: Illegal content, non-consensual intimate imagery, harassment, copyright infringement, or attempts to evade safety systems.

sections.title: How to report
sections.body: Email report@vidforge.ai with the task ID or URL, a description, and any supporting evidence. Do not include the abusive content itself if avoidable.

sections.title: Response
sections.body: We review reports promptly and may remove content, suspend accounts, or notify authorities as required.

sections.title: Emergency
sections.body: If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about VidForge.

sections.title: How does VidForge work?
sections.body: Enter a prompt (and optional reference image), choose a model, and we generate a video. Credits are deducted per generation.

sections.title: What models are available?
sections.body: See the Compare page for the full list of available models, providers, and costs.

sections.title: How much does it cost?
sections.body: Plans start on the Pricing page. You can also buy credit packages on the Billing page.

sections.title: Can I use generated videos commercially?
sections.body: Commercial use depends on your plan and the model provider's terms. Check plan features for details.

sections.title: How long does generation take?
sections.body: Most videos complete within a few minutes. Complex or longer videos may take longer.

sections.title: Is my data private?
sections.body: We follow our Privacy Policy. Uploaded media is used only to fulfill your request.

sections.title: How do I get a refund?
sections.body: See the Refund Policy. Email support@vidforge.ai with your order details.
